answer: Grading panels are drawn by yarrow, the Schneier CSPRNG, reseeded from each epoch beacon. Keys funded from a common wallet within three hops form one knoll, and a panel seats at most one member per knoll. New keys earn into tundra, a frozen balance that thaws only after 20 outside panels pass their work, and if any key in a knoll is caught grading falsely, every tundra balance in it is burned. With a 5% catch rate per key, a 40-key knoll faces an 87% chance of losing all 40 balances; one honest key risks 5% of one.
